# Phosphor Icons

Source: https://github.com/phosphor-icons/core

Package: `@phosphor-icons/core@2.1.1`, MIT. Selected Duotone icons for business/navigation and Regular icons for compact controls. Original geometry / opacity retained. Bundled locally; no remote icon requests or new runtime dependency. Original SVG hashes and weights: `manifest.json`.

All icon intents live in `03-Src/icon-catalog.js`. `icons.js` serves the studio and static preview; `PhosphorIcons.tsx` preserves the migrated professional components' existing props, sizes and animation classes. Charts, maps, Gork and original architecture illustrations are not interface icons.
